mapper.sql: C.COMMENT_ID AS ID, C.DIARY_ID, C.AUTHOR_ID, U.USER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, U.ROLES AS AUTHOR_ROLES, C.CONTENT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(C.CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(C.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 AS UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM DIARY_COMMENT C JOIN USER_INFO U ON U.USER_ID = C.AUTHOR_ID WHERE C.DIARY_ID = #{diaryId} AND C.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT, C.COMMENT_ID
SELECT FROM DIARY_COMMENT C JOIN USER_INFO U ON U.USER_ID = C.AUTHOR_ID WHERE C.COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND C.IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DIARY_COMMENT (COMMENT_ID, DIARY_ID, AUTHOR_ID, CONTENT) VALUES (#{id}, #{diaryId}, #{authorId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE DIARY_COMMENT C JOIN DIARY D ON D.DIARY_ID = C.DIARY_ID JOIN CONTENT_MASTER CM ON CM.CONTENT_ID = D.CONTENT_ID SET C.IS_DELETED = 'Y', C.DELETED_AT = NOW() WHERE C.COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND CM.USER_ID = #{ownerId} AND CM.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND C.IS_DELETED = 'N'
